market.question: Will the highest temperature in Munich be 21°C or higher on April 28?

assessment.reasoning: Munich Apr 28 2026 forecast high is around 16°C per multiple weather aggregators (weather25, easeweather), with April normals 14-17°C. The market resolves Yes only if the buckets covering 21°C or higher win. That requires about 5°C above the forecast/normal range, which is uncommon but not unheard of when a warm southerly wind (Föhn) sets up over Munich. Lean below market.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Forecasts can shift a few °C; a Föhn event could push highs into the 20s.
